reason: Clearing debris seems like a useful start to repairing the wound.
expectation: Phagocytes will engulf debris near the cut, preparing the area for repair.

alternatives.reason: Growing a blood supply also seems relevant, but I chose to clear the wound first.

effect: The wound is cleaned, so I can proceed with building support for repair.
reaction: The result matched my expectation, though it added little beyond the picture.
reason: Repair signals directed at a nearby capillary seem likely to establish a blood supply for the healing tissue.
expectation: The capillary may sprout toward the wound and help supply the repairing tissue.

alternatives.reason: Fibroblasts also seem useful for building support, but I want to establish the blood supply first.

effect: The capillary sprout is connected to the circulation and can now be added to the wound.
reaction: The result matched my expectation; seeing it remain connected makes its role clearer.
reason: Adding the sprout to the wound should help supply the repairing tissue.
expectation: The cleaned wound will gain a growing blood vessel connected to the existing circulation.

alternatives.reason: Fibroblasts may help build the supporting tissue, but I want to connect the new vessel first.

effect: The wound now has named surface and support slots, with the capillary branches connected to circulation.
reaction: The two slots make the remaining repair work clear.
reason: Fibroblasts and matrix nutrients seem suited to building the wound's supporting layer.
expectation: They will produce material that can support the healing skin.

alternatives.reason: The epidermal cells likely help close the surface, but I chose to build support first.

effect: The fibroblasts produced collagen-rich connective tissue that appears suited to the support slot.
reaction: The picture makes the fibroblasts' role clearer.
reason: I want to add the new connective tissue to the wound's supporting layer.
expectation: The connective tissue will fill the support slot in the healing skin.

alternatives.reason: The epidermal cells should help close the surface, but I want to fit the support first.

effect: The wound has connective-tissue support, though the new tissue is still weaker than uninjured skin.
reaction: The distinction between closing the wound and regaining strength is useful.
reason: The only offered combination should prepare cells to close the remaining surface.
expectation: The epidermal edge cells will use the nutrients to produce a new surface layer.

effect: The epidermal cells formed a new surface that can fill the remaining wound slot.
reaction: The picture clearly shows the surface growing across the gap.
reason: The only offered combination should close the skin over the new support.
expectation: The new surface will be fitted to the healing skin and close the wound.

effect: The surface is closed and supported, though the deeper tissue is still gaining strength; the temporary clot remains to be cleared.
reaction: The reminder that repair continues after closure is useful.
reason: The only offered combination addresses the remaining goal of clearing the temporary clot.
expectation: The enzymes will break down the fibrin in the temporary clot as the wound heals.

effect: The temporary clot has mostly cleared, while the new tissue and a still-maturing scar remain. Both goals are complete.
reaction: The remaining scar makes the distinction between clot removal and continuing repair clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the connective tissue was most worthwhile because the result explained that collagen supports the wound but young tissue is still weaker than uninjured skin.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the capillary sprout felt repetitive: its creation already showed it growing toward the wound, and the next action fitted it into the body.

surprise.text: The distinction between a closed surface and deeper tissue that is still gaining strength sharpened my understanding of healing.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though several fittings were predictable and the compatible-options menu made them easy to follow.

continue.text: I would probably stop here. The biology of continuing repair was interesting, but the repeated creation and fitting steps offered few meaningful choices.
